title: Building with AI & Azure
user_comment: The three latest posts by publication date, with short text excerpts. Full articles are available at their URLs.

items.title: AI Agents Exploit Leaked Keys in Minutes: Go Keyless on Azure
items.content_text: Microsoft saw an AI agent move from a GitHub secret search to Key Vault data theft in five minutes. Learn how keyless Azure AI reduces the risk.

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI vs Local vs Cloud: Agents Explained (2026)
items.content_text: Compare GitHub Copilot CLI, Local and cloud agents in 2026. Learn where the Copilot SDK fits, how sessions run, and what sub-agents and AI Credits cost.

items.title: MCP Goes Stateless: No Handshake, No Sticky Sessions, Better AI Gateways
items.content_text: MCP 2026-07-28 removes handshakes and sticky sessions. Learn what changes for Azure API Management, per-tool routing, retries, tracing and secure tool access.
